en.name: DigiLocker
en.description: Digital locker to store and share verified electronic documents issued by government agencies; reduce physical paperwork.
en.eligibility: Indian citizens with Aadhaar (used for sign-up).
en.benefits: Instant access to issued documents (marksheets, licences), verified e-documents, paperless verification.
application_steps: Sign up at digilocker.gov.in with Aadhaar OTP.
Fetch issued documents from registered issuers.
Upload personal documents; share via URI/QR.
faqs: How do I sign up for DigiLocker?
How do I share a DigiLocker document?
